cu.rec.cold.body: One well-timed call and one email from {store}, then move to the monthly nurture list. Before a desk manager spends time on it, check whether a lower trim or a different segment fits the payment the customer can carry. Escalate only if they book and show.

cu.rec.cold.title: Long-shot lead
cu.rec.hot.body: Call from {store} within the hour and book a same-day or next-day appointment. Confirm with a text now and a reminder two hours before the visit. Have F&I pre-qualify before they arrive. No extra discount is needed to hold this one.
cu.rec.hot.title: Hot lead: work it now
cu.rec.warm.body: Assign to {store}'s BDC for 6–8 touches across call, text and email over the next 14–21 days, leading with an appointment rather than a price. If they stall, a stronger trade allowance or a rate buy-down that lowers the monthly payment moves this deal, not sticker discount. Re-score once the appointment is set.
